schemes.official_name: Capstone: Advanced Projects (NYU Wagner Capstone, CAP-GP)
schemes.description: Wagner School MPA/MUP capstone: teams of 3-5 graduate students in their final two semesters work for a client organisation (nonprofit, governmental, health, planning, international agencies) or on a social question, producing e.g. literature review, environmental scan, operational framework, financial model or policy recommendations, with a final report and presentation. Clients apply via a spring RFP; faculty select projects; clients typically own the work product.

schemes.eligible_faculties_programmes: MPA and MUP students in final two semesters (further Wagner programme variants e.g. Global Policy Leaders, Health listed as separate course sections)

schemes.project_evidence: Teams work on a client challenge or research question; deliverables incl. final report and presentation [1].

schemes.employer_evidence: External client organisations submit proposals via spring RFP, are vetted, and the final work product is typically owned by the client; client FAQ states min. 3 years operating / 3 FTE and a suggested $5,000 engagement fee [1]. profile_md: NYU provides several distributed, mostly postgraduate programme-embedded routes where student teams work for external organisations; no single institution-wide scheme is compulsory. The strongest are compulsory team capstones: Wagner's Capstone (teams of 3-5 MPA/MUP students over the final two semesters working for nonprofit, governmental and health clients selected via an annual RFP; client owns the final report), the Tandon CUSP capstone (teams of 3-5 MS Urban Data Science students over two semesters for government, company and nonprofit sponsors, 2026-27 cycle confirmed), and Stern's NYC Consulting Capstone (taken by all Stern BS in Business seniors; faculty-led teams paired with a corporate partner per section, e.g. McDonald's and SoHo Broadway BID in Fall 2025 syllabi, Microsoft Garage in 2024). The only route open across schools is the SPS Real World courses (2-3 credit electives, application-based; multidisciplinary teams answer an industry partner's challenge and pitch to its executives; Fall 2026 applications confirmed). The CDS MS Data Science capstone (groups of 2-4, partner-proposed) mixes external companies and NYU labs, so employer connection is Unclear. Stern Solutions (graduate, for-credit client teams) is undated. Many other leads (law clinics, Consulting Corps, CGA practicums, Steinhardt studios) were not assessed. Wagner pages returned 403 on direct fetch, so Wagner evidence is search-extract only. Participation numbers are largely unpublished.
gaps: Reduced-depth review (~8 searches, ~9 fetches). Wagner pages 403 (not bypassed): evidence is search summary. Stern syllabus PDFs unreadable. Further instances likely: Stern Consulting Corps/Signature Projects, SPS CGA practicums, Law clinics, other Tandon departmental senior design, Steinhardt/Tisch studios. Summer Launchpad excluded as accelerator.
